record.tooling: POST /artifacts/:secureFilename/public-url with expiresAt, returning a public URL; GET /artifacts/:secureFilename. API token required (`x-auth-token`).
record.chaining: Unlimited accounts x 500 free minutes; artifact volume is bounded by what you can build in 500 min/month. 'No expiration' links mean the URL outlives nothing. The artifact is still deleted by team retention policy.
record.limits_note: 500 min/month free. 'No expiration' applies to the LINK, not the artifact. Retention policy still deletes the file (explicit in their KB). Build dashboards give only 24-hour artifact links.
record.reliability_note: 'No expiration' is a misleading label: the link persists but the artifact is removed by retention policy, so links rot. 500 min/month is a hard build ceiling.
